translations.idiomatic: As inner consorts entered the gate, to the tune 《Huian》

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven's nine consorts; the royal palace's six chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Nine consorts for the Son of Heaven; six chambers in the royal palace.

translations.literal: There was radiant, fine bearing — bearing the splendid ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Radiant was their noble bearing — each rank arrayed in splendor.

translations.literal: Blessed steps, peace brought — thrift in use, personal frugality.
translations.idiomatic: Blessed peace attended them; thrift in living was their way.

translations.literal: She set forth her virtuous fame — thereby to come and advise.
translations.idiomatic: She made her virtue known — and came to counsel in turn.

sentences.zh: 外命婦入門，《鹹安》象服之文，《鵲巢》之風。

translations.literal: As outer-court consorts entered, 《Xian'an》: Pattern of elephant robes; wind of 《Quechao》.
translations.idiomatic: As outer consorts entered, to the tune 《Xian'an》: Robes of ceremonial pattern; the spirit of 《Quechao》.

translations.literal: Transformed by the woman's Way — audience in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Shaped by wifely duty, they came to audience in the inner palace.

translations.literal: Gathering duckweed on the stream's bank; gathering algae mid-stream.
translations.idiomatic: They gathered duckweed by the brook; they gathered algae from the stream.

translations.literal: Early and late in public duty — praising that accumulated merit.
translations.idiomatic: Dawn to dusk in service — hymning deeds piled high.

sentences.zh: 皇后降坐，《和安》光佑晏寧，惠慈燕喜。

translations.literal: As the empress descended from her seat, 《Hean》: Bright blessing, tranquil peace; kind grace, joyous repose.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress left her seat, to the tune 《Hean》: Light and peace guarded her; kindness and joy filled her days.

translations.literal: Longevity and benevolence alike exalted; state and clan, equal blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Long life and mercy rose together; realm and house shared one blessing.

translations.literal: Fine pattern interwoven; inner registers, beauty succeeding.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid texts intertwined; the inner canon, beauty handed on.

translations.literal: For a hundred million myriad years — love and reverence alike.
translations.idiomatic: For endless myriad years — love and honor as one.

sentences.zh: 皇后歸閣，《泰安》天心仁佑，坤德世昭。

translations.literal: As the empress returned to her pavilion, 《Taian》: Heaven's heart, benevolent blessing; Kun's virtue, glory through the ages.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress withdrew to her pavilion, to the tune 《Taian》: Heaven's heart showed mercy; Earth's virtue shone through the ages.

translations.literal: Clearly there was loving pattern — shown in successive courts.
translations.idiomatic: Her loving example stood plain — written across many reigns.

translations.literal: Thrift to praise Yu; diligence to follow Yao.
translations.idiomatic: With thrift she echoed Yu; with diligence she followed Yao.

translations.literal: Therefore they took it as model — together striving from early night.
translations.idiomatic: So all took her as their model — striving together from dusk to dawn.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰三年皇后冊寶十三首

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiatai, empress registers and seals — thirteen hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Jiatai 3 — thirteen hymns for the empress's registers and seals.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升坐，《乾安》茂建坤極，容典聿新。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended to his seat, 《Qian'an》: Abundantly establishing Kun's summit; deportment canon, newly ordained.
translations.idiomatic: As the emperor took his seat, to the tune 《Qian'an》: Earth's height was firmly raised; the rites of bearing were made new.

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate what he praised; loving instruction was what he followed.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's charge was his boast; his mother's teaching was his guide.

translations.literal: Solemnly choosing the auspicious dawn — personally attending the Purple Court.
translations.idiomatic: On the sacred day chosen with care, he himself presided in the Purple Hall.

translations.literal: Great blessing piled on blessing; twin gifts converging together.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing heaped on blessing; paired gifts gathered as one.

translations.literal: Envoys and deputies entered the gate, 《Zheng'an》
translations.idiomatic: When envoys and deputies entered the gate, to the tune 《Zheng'an》

translations.literal: At dawn the main gate opened; auspicious qi, clouds congealing.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the gate swung wide; lucky clouds gathered overhead.

translations.literal: There were stately worthy assistants — treading in martial steps to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Noble ministers stood ready — marching in step to the throne.

translations.literal: Solemn, solemn the king's command — to bear it, to receive it.
translations.idiomatic: Grave and clear the royal command — to carry it forth, to receive it.

translations.literal: Ascending the register in Deep Clarity — ten thousand years, forever received.
translations.idiomatic: The register was raised in Deep Clarity — may ten thousand years receive it.

sentences.zh: 冊寶出門，《正安》瑤冊玉寶，爛然瑞輝。

translations.literal: As registers and seals went out the gate, 《Zheng'an》: Jasper registers, jade treasure — brilliantly, auspicious radiance.
translations.idiomatic: When registers and seals were borne forth, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: Registers of jade, seals of treasure — bright with auspicious light.

translations.literal: Crimson credentials at the side — upward receiving the Purple Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: Red warrants at their flanks — bearing tribute to the Purple Court on high.

translations.literal: Jade pendants chimed at morning audience — slowly issuing from the beast gate.
translations.idiomatic: Jade pendants rang at morning court — they passed slowly through the beast gate.

translations.literal: Ascending to Kun's summit — further displaying the canonical emblem.
translations.idiomatic: They mounted to Earth's height — the ritual emblem shone the brighter.

sentences.zh: 皇帝降坐，《乾安》天臨黼扆，雲集弁纓。

translations.literal: As the emperor descended from his seat, 《Qian'an》: Heaven overlooking the brocaded screen; clouds gathering, caps and tassels.
translations.idiomatic: As the emperor left his seat, to the tune 《Qian'an》: Heaven gazed on the brocaded throne; clouds of caps and tassels thronged the hall.

translations.literal: Metal and stone sounded in turn; ritual canon fully complete.
translations.idiomatic: Bronze and stone answered in turn; every rite stood complete.

translations.literal: Jade steps in measured pace; dragon carriage, wings in motion.
translations.idiomatic: His jade steps moved with measured grace; the dragon coach spread its wings.

translations.literal: Words turning to the North Star — forever feasting in Western Clarity.
translations.idiomatic: He turned toward the Pole Star — to rest forever in Western Clarity.

sentences.zh: 皇后出閣，《乾安》日薰椒屋，雲靄璧門。

translations.literal: As the empress came forth from her pavilion, 《Qian'an》: Sun warming the pepper chambers; clouds misting the jade gate.
translations.idiomatic: As the empress left her pavilion, to the tune 《Qian'an》: Sunlight warmed the pepper halls; clouds veiled the jade gate.

translations.literal: There were splendid auspicious credentials — coming from the emperor's gate.
translations.idiomatic: Bright tokens of blessing came — sent from the emperor's gate.

translations.literal: Presiding over Heaven was Qian; matching virtue was Kun.
translations.idiomatic: Qian ruled Heaven; Kun matched it in virtue.

translations.literal: Our dragon received it — blessing and rank, forever abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Our sovereign received it — fortune and rank without end.

translations.literal: As registers and seals entered the gate, 《Yian》
translations.idiomatic: When registers and seals came within, to the tune 《Yian》

translations.literal: Rainbow brilliance, splendid; cloud script, silken and dense.
translations.idiomatic: Rainbow light flared; cloud-scrolls lay rich as silk.

translations.literal: Crimson credentials led before; auspicious light floated above.
translations.idiomatic: Crimson banners went ahead; lucky light hovered above.

translations.literal: Jade steps, jade doors — immediately gathering at Changqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Past jade steps and jade doors, they came at once to Long Autumn.

translations.literal: Reverently receiving Heaven's favor — forever bearing the emperor's grace.
translations.idiomatic: She received Heaven's gift with reverence — forever bearing the emperor's grace.

sentences.zh: 皇后降殿，《承安》瑤殿清，玉墄坦夷。

translations.literal: As the empress descended from the hall, 《Chengan》: Jade hall, clear; jade steps, level and open.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress left the hall, to the tune 《Chengan》: The jade hall stood clear; the jade steps lay smooth and even.

translations.literal: Sacred robes with hairpins attached — ascending and descending without delay.
translations.idiomatic: In sacred robes and jeweled pins, she rose and descended without delay.

translations.literal: Treasure registers then arrived — laden with solemnity, laden with reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The treasure registers came — borne in solemn reverence.

translations.literal: Ritual pattern brightly prepared — blessed steps, everlasting peace.
translations.idiomatic: Every rite stood bright in order — peace and blessing without end.

sentences.zh: 皇后受冊寶，《成安》日月臨燭，乾坤覆持。

translations.literal: As the empress received registers and seals, 《Chengan》: Sun and moon illumined and shone; Qian and Kun covered and upheld.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress received registers and seals, to the tune 《Chengan》: Sun and moon lit the world; Heaven and Earth held all in embrace.

translations.literal: Brightness matching the two luminaries; virtue joining the two ritual ones.
translations.idiomatic: Her light rivaled the two lights; her virtue matched the paired powers.

translations.literal: Glory rivaling the imperial summit — together restoring the transforming foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Her splendor matched the throne — together they renewed the realm's foundation.

translations.literal: Receiving the abundant canon — a hundred million ages, forever fitting.
translations.idiomatic: She received the great canon — fit for endless ages.

sentences.zh: 皇后升坐，《和安》寶璽瑤冊，既祗既承。

translations.literal: As the empress ascended to her seat, 《Hean》: Treasure seal, jasper register — already reverent, already received.
translations.idiomatic: As the empress took her seat, to the tune 《Hean》: Seal of treasure, register of jade — received with reverence, borne with care.

translations.literal: Embroidered mat, patterned seat — now mounting, now rising.
translations.idiomatic: On broidered mat and figured seat, she mounted step by step.

translations.literal: Gentle ceremony, solemn and still; auspicious charge, upright and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Gentle rite, grave and still; her blessed charge, firm and clear.

translations.literal: Forever receiving many blessings — like a river ever swelling.
translations.idiomatic: May she receive endless blessing — like a river ever rising.

translations.literal: As inner-court consorts entered, 《Huian》
translations.idiomatic: As inner consorts entered the gate, to the tune 《Huian》

translations.literal: Robes in splendid ceremony; ranks divided in flowering order.
translations.idiomatic: Robes blazed in full ceremony; ranks stood in ordered splendor.

translations.literal: Nine consorts, wifely duties; six chambers, inner governance.
translations.idiomatic: Nine consorts with their wifely tasks; six chambers with inner rule.

translations.literal: Uneven the water-cress — seeking diligence, waking and sleeping.
translations.idiomatic: Water-cress here and there — they strove in wakeful duty.

translations.literal: Abundantly they came in thought — mutual rites praising the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: They gathered in reverent throng — each rite praising the offering.

sentences.zh: 外命婦入門，《鹹安》婦榮於室，通籍禁中。

translations.literal: As outer-court consorts entered, 《Xian'an》: A wife's glory in her chamber — registry in the forbidden inner.
translations.idiomatic: As outer consorts entered, to the tune 《Xian'an》: Honor in the household; their names entered the inner court.

translations.literal: Ranks arrayed with order; carriages and robes with proper bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Each rank kept its place; carriage and robe showed due form.

translations.literal: Assisting our 《Guan Ju》; wind of 《Quechao》.
translations.idiomatic: They aided our 《Guan Ju》; they kept the spirit of 《Quechao》.

translations.literal: Robes draped full and even — how could they not be solemn and harmonious!
translations.idiomatic: Robes spread wide and even — all solemn, all in harmony!

sentences.zh: 皇后降坐，《徽安》金石具舉，典禮茂明。

translations.literal: As the empress descended from her seat, 《Huian》: Metal and stone all raised; ritual canon, luxuriant and bright.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress left her seat, to the tune 《Huian》: Bronze and stone rang out; the rite stood rich and bright.

translations.literal: Pure and cautious in her stopping — swiftly to behold its completion.
translations.idiomatic: Pure and careful in her bearing — she saw the rite fulfilled.

translations.literal: Fine jade pendants slightly moving; phoenix carriage, wings in travel.
translations.idiomatic: Fine jade swayed at her girdle; the phoenix coach spread its wings.

translations.literal: Ceremonial splendor rivaling the summit; virtue surpassing the consort capital.
translations.idiomatic: Her ritual glory matched the throne; her virtue outshone the ancient queens.

sentences.zh: 皇后歸閣，《泰安》寶坐既興，鳳輿戒行。

translations.literal: As the empress returned to her pavilion, 《Taian》: Treasure seat already raised; phoenix carriage, warned for departure.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress withdrew to her pavilion, to the tune 《Taian》: The jeweled seat was set; the phoenix coach was called to go.

translations.literal: Music of release from vigil performed; returning to feast in deep clarity.
translations.idiomatic: The rite of standing down was done; she returned to rest in deep quiet.

translations.literal: Inquiring after the empress dowager's longevity and kindness; offering at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: She asked after the dowager's health and grace; she made offering at the ancestral shrine.

translations.literal: For a thousand myriad years — inner aid to sagely brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: For a thousand myriad years — aiding the sage emperor from within.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十五年皇帝受“恭膺天命之寶”三首

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Jiading, the emperor received the "Treasure of Reverent Bearing of Heaven's Mandate" — three hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 15 — three hymns for the emperor's receipt of the "Seal of Reverent Bearing of Heaven's Mandate."

sentences.zh: 《恭膺天命之曲》，太簇宮我祖受命，恭膺於天。

translations.literal: 《Tune of Reverent Bearing of Heaven's Mandate》, Taicu mode: Our ancestor received the mandate, reverently bearing it from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: 《Tune of Reverent Bearing of Heaven's Mandate》, in the Taicu mode: Our forebear received the charge, reverently bearing Heaven's command.

translations.literal: Thereupon making the jade treasure — laden with reverence, laden with devotion.
translations.idiomatic: He fashioned the jade seal — borne in reverence and devotion.

translations.literal: Extended blessing without limit — sacred succession has its transmission.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing spread without end — the sacred line has its heir.

translations.literal: Brightly now this rising fortune — for ten thousand such years!
translations.idiomatic: Brightly shines this new fortune — for ten thousand years!

translations.literal: 《Tune of the Old Domain Returning》, Taicu mode
translations.idiomatic: 《Tune of the Old Domain Returning》, in the Taicu mode

translations.literal: Oh, august our sovereign — in virtue, pure.
translations.idiomatic: How great our emperor — pure in virtue.

translations.literal: Moistening all living things — how much more our remnant people.
translations.idiomatic: He nourishes every living soul — all the more our people left behind.

translations.literal: Fortune aligned, spanning Jin — tribute rendered, treasures offered.
translations.idiomatic: His fortune spanned the age, crossing Jin — tribute came, treasures were offered.

translations.literal: Territory daily expanding — one view, one kindness.
translations.idiomatic: His realm grew day by day — one realm, one boundless grace.

sentences.zh: 《永清四海之曲》，太簇宮我祖我宗，德厚澤深。

translations.literal: 《Tune of Everlasting Clarity for the Four Seas》, Taicu mode: Our ancestors, our forebears — virtue thick, blessing deep.
translations.idiomatic: 《Tune of Everlasting Clarity for the Four Seas》, in the Taicu mode: Ancestors and forebears — virtue deep, blessing rich.

translations.literal: Oh, glorious succession — further singling this heart.
translations.idiomatic: Glorious is the line that follows — ever more single in purpose.

translations.literal: Heaven and humanity assisting together — unity, there to face.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and men joined as one — the realm stood united before him.

translations.literal: Qian and Kun cleared and level — stirring the ages, now.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth stood clear and calm — a wonder from of old to this day.

sentences.zh: 至道元年冊皇太子二首太子出入，《正安》主鬯之重，允屬賢明。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhidao, enfeoffing the crown prince — two hymns. As the crown prince entered and exited, 《Zheng'an》: The weight of the libation vessel — truly belonged to the worthy and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Zhidao 1 — two hymns for investing the crown prince. As the heir entered and withdrew, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: The charge of the sacred vessel — rightly his, worthy and bright.

translations.literal: The Eastern Palace was first opened — the heir's excellence soared.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace was newly raised — the heir's glory mounted on high.

translations.literal: Rites cultivated, music raised — nurturing virtue, opening glory.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were perfected, music was lifted — virtue nurtured, honor opened.

translations.literal: One man, the chief good — ten thousand states thereby at peace.
translations.idiomatic: One man, the first and best — and all the realm was calm.

sentences.zh: 群臣稱賀，《正安》皇儲既建，聖祚無疆。

translations.literal: The host of ministers offered congratulations, 《Zheng'an》: The imperial heir already established — sacred reign without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers offered congratulations, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: The heir was named — the sacred reign knows no end.

translations.literal: Phoenix banners arrayed in order; cock-halberds ranked in files.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix banners lined in ranks; ceremonial halberds filed in rows.

translations.literal: The former star had brilliance; the auspicious sun, redoubled light.
translations.idiomatic: The heir star shone bright; the lucky sun redoubled its light.

translations.literal: Reaching Heaven, meeting the sage — cultured pattern, truly good.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven-high, sage-near — refined grace, truly fair.

sentences.zh: 天禧三年冊皇太子一首太子出入，《明安》明《離》之象，少陽之位。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianxi, enfeoffing the crown prince — one hymn. As the crown prince entered and exited, 《Ming'an》: The brightness of 《Li》's image — the lesser yang's position.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 3 — one hymn for investing the crown prince. As the heir entered and withdrew, to the tune 《Ming'an》: The image of 《Li》 shone clear — the place of lesser yang.

translations.literal: Securing the state as foundation; embodying Heaven as second.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was his root; Heaven made him second only to the throne.

translations.literal: Model and bearing could be warm; ritual pattern was thereby complete.
translations.idiomatic: His bearing was mild and fair; every rite stood complete.

translations.literal: Greatly proclaiming fine plans — reverently guarding the ancestral vessel.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed noble counsel — and guarded the sacred vessel.

sentences.zh: 太子入門，《明安》於維皇儲，玉潤金聲。

translations.literal: As the crown prince entered the gate, 《Ming'an》: Oh, the imperial heir — jade lustrous, gold sounding.
translations.idiomatic: When the heir entered the gate, to the tune 《Ming'an》: Oh, the royal heir — bright as jade, clear as gold.

translations.literal: Embodying 《Zhen》's advance; doubling 《Li》's brightness.
translations.idiomatic: He bore the thrust of 《Zhen》; he doubled the light of 《Li》.

translations.literal: Registers and seals all raised; ring-pendants chimed and rang.
translations.idiomatic: Registers and seals were lifted high; girdle gems chimed as one.

translations.literal: Guarding the vessel, continuing the ancestral line — the state's glory.
translations.idiomatic: He kept the sacred vessel, carried on the line — glory of the realm.

translations.literal: As the crown prince went out the gate, 《Ming'an》
translations.idiomatic: When the heir left the gate, to the tune 《Ming'an》

translations.literal: Music prepared, already performed; harmonious sound, penetrating and blended.
translations.idiomatic: The music was ready and played; harmony filled the air.

translations.literal: Jade slips, gold writing; soaring phoenixes, sporting swans.
translations.idiomatic: Jade tablets, gold script; phoenixes soared, swans sported above.

translations.literal: Descending the steps to receive — turning to the Azure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed and received — then turned toward the Eastern Palace.

translations.literal: Ritual time made him second — blessings flowing without end.
translations.idiomatic: The rite made him second in the land — blessing without end.

sentences.zh: 皇帝降坐，《乾安》我禮備成，我駕言旋。

translations.literal: As the emperor descended from his seat, 《Qian'an》: My rites fully complete — I mount my carriage to return.
translations.idiomatic: As the emperor left his seat, to the tune 《Qian'an》: The rite was done — I take my carriage home.

translations.literal: Descending from the seat and clearing the path — drums struck, deep and rolling.
translations.idiomatic: He left his seat; the way was cleared — drums rolled deep and far.

translations.literal: The foundation of the state already fixed — blessing and protection from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The realm's root was set — Heaven's blessing guarded it.

translations.literal: May he flourish in his heirs — how many tens of thousands of years!
translations.idiomatic: May his line flourish — for ten thousand myriad years!

sentences.zh: 乾道七年冊皇太子四首皇帝升坐，《乾安》建儲以賢，辟宮於東。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qiandao, enfeoffing the crown prince — four hymns. The emperor ascended to his seat, 《Qian'an》: Establishing the heir by worth — opening a palace to the east.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 7 — four hymns for investing the crown prince. As the emperor took his seat, to the tune 《Qian'an》: The heir was chosen for merit — a palace opened in the east.

translations.literal: Canonical registers already prepared; milfoil divination already followed.
translations.idiomatic: The canon was ready; the oracle had spoken assent.

translations.literal: Numerous and grand the ministers; ringing and chiming drums and bells.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers thronged the hall; bells and drums rang out.

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven arrived and stopped — how grand the ritual bearing!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor came to his place — how grand the ceremony!

sentences.zh: 太子入門，《明安》周瑉差々，篆金煌煌。

translations.literal: As the crown prince entered the gate, 《Ming'an》: Zhou jade, tier on tier; seal script gold, blazing bright.
translations.idiomatic: When the heir entered the gate, to the tune 《Ming'an》: Jade of Zhou, rank on rank; golden script, blazing bright.

translations.literal: Facing and proclaiming in the court — to bear it, to uphold it.
translations.idiomatic: He faced the court and was hailed — to bear the charge, to uphold it.

translations.literal: Stars redoubled their brilliance; sun redoubled its light.
translations.idiomatic: The stars burned twice as bright; the sun redoubled its light.

translations.literal: Gazing up with joy — the state has its chief good.
translations.idiomatic: All looked up rejoicing — the realm had its heir.

sentences.zh: 太子出門，《明安》淵中象德，玉裕凝姿。

translations.literal: As the crown prince went out the gate, 《Ming'an》: Deep within, elephant virtue; jade fullness, congealed bearing.
translations.idiomatic: When the heir left the gate, to the tune 《Ming'an》: Virtue deep as an elephant; bearing firm as jade.

translations.literal: Advancing, retreating, circling — there was solemnity in his bearing.
translations.idiomatic: In advance and retreat he turned — grave and correct in every move.

translations.literal: Already fixing the foundation of the state — further exalting the base of celebration.
translations.idiomatic: The realm's root was fixed — the ground of joy rose higher still.

translations.literal: Feast reaching both palaces — blessing and rank like thatch piled high.
translations.idiomatic: Joy reached both palaces — fortune heaped high as hay.

translations.literal: As the emperor descended from his seat, 《Qian'an》
translations.idiomatic: As the emperor left his seat, to the tune 《Qian'an》

translations.literal: Heir and assistant already fixed — vessel of the public!
translations.idiomatic: The heir was chosen — vessel of the realm!

translations.literal: Register bestowal, timely hour — ritual, how grand!
translations.idiomatic: Registers given at the sacred hour — how grand the rite!

translations.literal: Heaven's pace, slow and slow — turning through the ninefold gates!
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's pace moved slow — through the ninefold gates he turned!

translations.literal: Blessed years, ten thousand — virtue without end!
translations.idiomatic: Blessed years without end — virtue that knows no bound!

sentences.zh: 嘉定二年冊皇太子四首皇帝升坐

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiading, enfeoffing the crown prince — four hymns. The emperor ascended to his seat
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 2 — four hymns for investing the crown prince. The emperor ascended to his seat

translations.literal: Oh, august our Song — receiving the mandate from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: How great our Song — Heaven's mandate was ours.

translations.literal: Raising the heir to hold the libation — extending celebration, divining the year.
translations.idiomatic: The heir was raised to hold the sacred cup — joy was spread, the year was blessed.

translations.literal: Canonical registers reported complete; court craftsmen, laden with reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The canon was declared ready; craftsmen of the court stood in reverence.

translations.literal: Ten thousand chariots arrived and stopped — correct caps, deep extension.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor came in state — cap correct, presence deep and far.

sentences.zh: 太子入門受冊寶太極端禦，少陽肅祗。

translations.literal: As the crown prince entered the gate to receive registers and seals: Supreme Ultimate, correct presence; lesser yang, solemn reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The heir entered to receive registers and seals: The Ultimate stood correct; lesser yang bowed in solemn reverence.

translations.literal: Jade slips thereby carved; ceremonial robes greatly fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Jade tablets were carved; ritual robes fit him well.

translations.literal: Playing complete music — then displaying the grand ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Full music was played — then the great rite was shown.

translations.literal: Descending the steps to receive — forever declaring, guard it.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed and received — forever charged to keep it safe.

sentences.zh: 太子受冊寶出門明兩承曜，作貳宣猷。

translations.literal: As the crown prince received registers and seals and went out the gate: Bright pairing receiving radiance — serving as second, proclaiming plans.
translations.idiomatic: The heir received registers and seals and went forth: Bright as paired lights — second to the throne, herald of counsel.

translations.literal: Abundant virtue, gold-bright; fine fame, river-flowing.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue rich and gold-bright; fame fine as a river's flow.

translations.literal: Pre-determining its root — forever leaving this plan.
translations.idiomatic: The root was set beforehand — a design for endless ages.

translations.literal: Three courts offered nurture — inquiring after rest in the Dragon Tower.
translations.idiomatic: Three courts gave him care — they asked after him in the Dragon Tower.

sentences.zh: 皇帝降坐《震》洊體象，我儲明兮。

translations.literal: As the emperor descended from his seat: 《Zhen》's advance, body-image — my heir, bright!
translations.idiomatic: As the emperor left his seat: 《Zhen》's advance, the image made plain — my heir shines bright!

translations.literal: Dispersing and raising the manifest register — my ritual, complete!
translations.idiomatic: The bright register was raised — the rite was done!

translations.literal: Great carriage about to turn — guards clearing, crying out!
translations.idiomatic: The great carriage turned — guards cleared the way with cry!

translations.literal: Feast-blessing without bound — the state's glory!
translations.idiomatic: Feast-blessing without end — glory of the realm!

sentences.zh: 寶祐二年皇子冠二十首

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoyou, capping the imperial son — twenty hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyou 2 — twenty hymns for the imperial son's capping.

sentences.zh: 皇帝將出文德殿，《隆安》於皇帝德，乃聖乃神。

translations.literal: As the emperor was about to leave Wende Hall, 《Long'an》: In the emperor's virtue — thus sage, thus divine.
translations.idiomatic: As the emperor was to leave Wende Hall, to the tune 《Long'an》: In the emperor's virtue — sage and divine.

translations.literal: Root and branch for a hundred ages — establishing love, only kin.
translations.idiomatic: Root and branch for a hundred generations — love founded on kinship.

translations.literal: Reverently joining the capping affair — thereby clarifying human relations.
translations.idiomatic: He reverently held the capping rite — and made human bonds clear.

translations.literal: Receiving Heaven, aiding order — glorious command thereby extended.
translations.idiomatic: He received Heaven and upheld order — the sacred charge spread wide.

translations.literal: Guest praise, entering the gate, 《Zhian》
translations.idiomatic: Guest praise, entering the gate, to the tune 《Zhian》

translations.literal: Abundant millet, legacy of plans — establish you, eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Rich grain, plans handed down — establish your eldest son.

translations.literal: Measuring ritual, measuring years — divining the guest, reverent service.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were weighed, years were chosen — the guest was divined, service made reverent.

translations.literal: Eight sounds could harmonize — fine guests arrived and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Eight tones joined in harmony — noble guests came to their places.

translations.literal: Thereby to cap him — completing his blessed steps.
translations.idiomatic: There they capped him — and his blessed path was complete.

translations.literal: Inner aid to worthy marquis — assisting the enlightened lord.
translations.idiomatic: Within she aided worthy lords — without she helped the sage king.

translations.literal: That magpie built its nest — precious birds, harmonious together.
translations.idiomatic: The magpie built its nest — rare birds lived in peace.

translations.literal: Evenly nurturing fine chicks — reaching to abundant breeding.
translations.idiomatic: They nursed the young with even care — till broods grew full.

translations.literal: Right: 《Quechao》 six chapters, four lines per chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Right: 《Quechao》 — six chapters of four lines each.

sentences.zh: 大觀聞喜宴六首狀元以下入門，《正安》多士濟濟，於彼西雍。

translations.literal: Daguan Wenxi banquet — six hymns. Top graduates and below entering the gate, 《Zheng'an》: Many scholars, numerous and grand — at that western Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Daguan Wenxi banquet — six hymns. As top graduates and the rest entered, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: Scholars thronged in hosts — at the western Yong.

translations.literal: Reverently solemn, majestic bearing — also there was this demeanor.
translations.idiomatic: Grave in bearing, grand in mien — each showed fitting grace.

translations.literal: Abundantly they came in thought — from west, from east.
translations.idiomatic: They gathered in reverent throng — from west and east alike.

translations.literal: Heaven bestows you blessing — only the king exalts it.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven gave them fortune — the king raised it high.

sentences.zh: 初舉酒，《賓興賢能》明明天子，率由舊章。

translations.literal: First raising of wine, 《Guest Rising, Worthy Able》: Bright bright the Son of Heaven — following the ancient pattern.
translations.idiomatic: First toast, 《Guest Rising, Worthy Able》: Bright shone the Son of Heaven — keeping to the ancient way.

translations.literal: Joy in the Pan waters — radiance to the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Joy at the Pan pool — light to the four quarters.

translations.literal: Lightly gathering its celery — using them as guests for the king.
translations.idiomatic: They gathered celery with care — to serve the king as guests.

translations.literal: I have fine ale — placing it on that Zhou walkway.
translations.idiomatic: I have good wine — set it on the royal walk.

sentences.zh: 再酌，《於樂辟雍》樂隻君子，式燕又思。

translations.literal: Second pouring, 《At the Joyful Yong》: Delighting this gentleman — feasting, again thoughtful.
translations.idiomatic: Second toast, 《At the Joyful Yong》: Joy for the noble guest — feast and thought as one.

translations.literal: Wearing his mandated robes — assisted by majestic bearing.
translations.idiomatic: He wore his ordered robes — aided by solemn grace.

translations.literal: Bells and drums already set — one morning, toasting him.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and drums were set — one morning they toasted him.

translations.literal: Virtuous fame is luxuriant — foundation of house and state.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue's fame grew rich — root of realm and home.

translations.literal: Third pouring, 《Joy in Nurturing Outstanding Talent》
translations.idiomatic: Third toast, 《Joy in Nurturing Outstanding Talent》

translations.literal: Sage counsels, vast and wide — governing the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: The sage's plans spread wide — ruling the four quarters.

translations.literal: Present our splendid scholars — viewing the state's bright light.
translations.idiomatic: We offer our finest scholars — to see the realm's glory.

translations.literal: Far be it not to make men — and the state thereby flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: How could men not be made? — and so the realm thrives.

translations.literal: Thereby feasting the Son of Heaven — ten thousand years, without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Thus they feasted the emperor — long life without end.

sentences.zh: 四酌，《樂且有儀》我求懿德，烝然來思。

translations.literal: Fourth pouring, 《Joy and Thereby Ritual》: I seek fine virtue — abundantly they come in thought.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth toast, 《Joy and Thereby Ritual》: I seek noble virtue — they gather in reverent throng.

translations.literal: Baskets and beans, quiet and fine — pattern feast, peace brought.
translations.idiomatic: Vessels stood still and fair — the feast brought peace.

translations.literal: Gentle, gentle their reverence — none without fine bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Gentle, gentle in reverence — each bore noble grace.

translations.literal: Carving and polishing their pattern — splendid scholars, thereby fitting.
translations.idiomatic: They carved and polished their art — fit for the finest men.

sentences.zh: 五酌，《正安》思皇多士，揚於王庭。

translations.literal: Fifth pouring, 《Zheng'an》: Thinking of the many scholars — raised in the king's court.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth toast, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: Think of the many scholars — raised in the royal court.

translations.literal: Bells and drums delight them — solemn harmony, harmonious sound.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and drums made joy — solemn harmony rang clear.

translations.literal: Majestic bearing, restrained — already at peace, already tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Grave bearing, calm and still — at peace, at rest.

translations.literal: Son of Heaven, ten thousand years — forever viewing its completion.
translations.idiomatic: May the Son of Heaven live ten thousand years — forever seeing the rite fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 政和鹿鳴宴五首初酌酒，《正安》思樂泮水，承流辟雍。

translations.literal: Zhenghe Luming banquet — five hymns. First pouring of wine, 《Zheng'an》: Joy in the Pan waters — receiving the stream, the Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe Luming banquet — five hymns. First toast, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: Joy at the Pan pool — the stream feeds the Yong.

translations.literal: Thinking of the many scholars — pattern bright, coming in followers.
translations.idiomatic: Think of the many scholars — splendid, they come in train.

translations.literal: Harmonious, harmonious, numerous and grand — four directions, thereby alike.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious and countless they came — all four quarters as one.

translations.literal: Ascending to the heavenly storehouse — only the king exalts them.
translations.idiomatic: They rose to the royal treasury — the king raised them high.

sentences.zh: 再酌，《樂育人才》鍾鼓皇皇，磬筦鏘鏘。

translations.literal: Second pouring, 《Joy in Nurturing Talent》: Bells and drums, august and bright; stone chimes and pipes, ringing and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Second toast, 《Joy in Nurturing Talent》: Bells and drums blazed bright; chimes and pipes rang clear.

translations.literal: Ascending and descending, timely — using them to serve the king.
translations.idiomatic: Rise and descent in season — that they may serve the king.

translations.literal: Splendid scholars, thereby fitting — the state's bright light.
translations.idiomatic: Fine scholars, fit for duty — glory of the realm.

translations.literal: Pleasing to the Son of Heaven — affair complete, words raised.
translations.idiomatic: Pleasing to the emperor — the rite done, praise proclaimed.

translations.literal: Third pouring, 《Worthy, Worthy, Good Virtue》
translations.idiomatic: Third toast, 《Worthy, Worthy, Good Virtue》

translations.literal: Calling deer, yo yo — bearing cap, sturdy and tall.
translations.idiomatic: The deer cried clear and long — caps worn, figures tall.

translations.literal: Abundantly they came in thought — fine wine, thought of softness.
translations.idiomatic: They gathered in reverent throng — fine wine, mild and sweet.

translations.literal: This child speaks of going — Pan spreading, you roaming.
translations.idiomatic: The youth spoke of going — the Pan waters wide, free to roam.

translations.literal: At that western Yong — facing and proclaiming the king's grace.
translations.idiomatic: At the western Yong — they hailed the king's blessing.

sentences.zh: 四酌，《烝我髦士》首善京師，灼於四方。

translations.literal: Fourth pouring, 《Present Our Splendid Scholars》: First goodness in the capital — brilliant to the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth toast, 《Present Our Splendid Scholars》: Excellence began in the capital — shining to every quarter.

translations.literal: Present our splendid scholars — gold and jade, their mutual aid.
translations.idiomatic: We offer our finest scholars — gold and jade, each aiding each.

translations.literal: Drinking wine music piece — blowing bamboo, drumming reeds.
translations.idiomatic: Drinking-song air — pipes blown, reeds drummed.

translations.literal: Exhort and warn the followers — viewing the state's bright light.
translations.idiomatic: Urge and warn the attendants — behold the realm's glory.

sentences.zh: 五酌，《利用賓王》遐不作人，天下喜樂。

translations.literal: Fifth pouring, 《Using Them to Serve the King》: Far be it not to make men — all under Heaven, joy and delight.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth toast, 《Using Them to Serve the King》: How could men not be made? — the world rejoiced.

translations.literal: With what to compare it?
translations.idiomatic: What can compare to it?

translations.literal: Kite flying, fish leaping.
translations.idiomatic: Kites soar, fish leap.

translations.literal: Already urging their carriage — offering and toasting, crossing and interweaving.
translations.idiomatic: They urged the guests to go — cups passed back and forth.

translations.literal: Using them to serve the king — tethering them with fine rank.
translations.idiomatic: That they may serve the king — bound with noble reward.
